note: A recorded decision script for the deterministic provider (spec §87).
There is no turn for the retry. The runtime does not ask the model again to
recover from a failed tool call: `retry_with_backoff` re-executes the same
action in the executor, and the model only sees the outcome (spec §34-35).
That is why turn 1 can talk about the total as if it had always been there.

turns.text: Asking the shop database for orders over 10000 cents.
